notice: UPSTREAM.json records the imported baseline; the files below intentionally contain local integration changes, not pristine upstream hashes.

patches.name: Nocturne token-time native tree integration, 2026-10-10
patches.purpose: Optional synchronous element creation/reaction boundaries; stable parser form-owner/is metadata; declarative shadow roots and content-patching template destinations.
patches.default_behavior: With optional embedder callbacks unset, ordinary upstream template construction and inert-template behavior remain in place.

patches.name: Current URL Standard hosts and UTS #46 validity, 2026-10-26
patches.purpose: ASCII domains (including xn-- labels) are only lowercased, also after percent-decoding; host/hostname setters keep a host the override parse set even when the port after it fails, and keep the old host when none was set; an IPv4 number stays a number only if every code point is a digit, also past an overflowing prefix (ends-in-a-number checker); UTS #46 CheckBidi, CheckJoiners (virama context) and the leading-combining-mark rule.
patches.default_behavior: Non-ASCII domains still go through Lexbor's IDNA with the same flags; CheckBidi/CheckJoiners only apply when the caller passes them. A ZWNJ outside a virama is not yet checked against Joining_Type.

patches.name: Encoding Standard decoders, encoders and labels, 2026-10-28
patches.purpose: Every label of the current standard (upstream's table lacked unicode11utf8, unicode20utf8, x-unicode20utf8, csunicode, iso-10646-ucs-2, ucs-2, unicode, unicodefeff, unicodefffe); the gb18030 and GBK encoders' GB18030-2022 side table (U+E78D..U+E864 to two bytes); gb18030 ranges pointer 39419 decodes to U+FFFF; the gb18030 decoder no longer carries a stale prepend into the next chunk after a three-byte prefix's error; the replacement decoder gives one error for non-empty input, then finished; ISO-2022-JP's end-of-queue by state (leading byte, Roman and katakana are finished, a trailing byte's ESC still errs, escape restores its leading byte); the ISO-2022-JP encoder does not output U+000E, U+000F or U+001B in jis0208 state; lxb_encoding_encode_or_fail_single gives encode or fail's ESC ( B before an error and U+FFFD as the error for those three; percent-encode after encoding outputs the bytes before an error, then %26%23N%3B.
patches.default_behavior: Decoding and encoding of every other byte sequence and scalar value are upstream's; tests/check_encoding.py compares all encoders on every BMP scalar value and all decoders on every one- and two-byte input with a reference written from the standard.
patches.generated: source/lexbor/encoding/res.c's lxb_encoding_res_shs_entities and its size in res.h by ports/lexbor/encoding_labels.py from the standard's encodings.json
